exclusions.reason: The original CPU4 round1 overlapped a brief syntax check of the navigation harness. interpretation.statistics: Per scenario/label/cache median/min/max only; counts are explicit per group. Target n=10 desktop, n=3 CPU/mobile, n=2 network. Pending excluded rounds reduce n until a complete clean replacement exists. No population p95 or attribution of physical-device performance.
interpretation.data: Official read-only rendering fixture, no authentication, remote session, essential data network, retries, RLS or public/commission token request. dataMs/routeDataWaitMs null are unmeasured, not zero.
interpretation.timing: Boot spans overlap; do not add CPU, upload, shader readiness/reflection or secondary hydration as if serial. Texture-upload marker includes work/scheduling, not isolated pure GPU upload.
interpretation.moduleWorker: moduleMs includes download/import/evaluation boundary; worker span includes request/worker startup/CPU/transfer and is not split into pure execution phases. RendererModuleMs may be null on rendering fixture importing Canvas statically.
interpretation.cache: Cold: fresh browser context plus Network.clearBrowserCache; warm: same-context reload retains browser/HTTP/CacheStorage; shader driver/OS cache uncontrolled. Server assets use public,max-age=3600, other paths no-cache. Warm transfer totals around 3370 bytes confirm asset response reuse in the healthy groups; body totals include cached resources. Browser routing was not used because it disables cache.
interpretation.network: Static loopback server has no compression; network scenario emulates 150 ms latency and 200000/100000 bytes per second download/upload. Transport is fixture asset timing, not production CDN/backend.
interpretation.environment: Chrome155 / ANGLE Metal AppleM5 healthy host. CPU4 and mobile viewport/touch are emulation on same GPU/driver, not old desktop, Android or Safari. Battery/power/temperature/clocks/background applications uncontrolled.
interpretation.memoryGpu: Heap is raw JS heap when available, not normalized GC or VRAM. Renderer geometries/textures/programs are counters, not bytes. Active GPU timing, disjoint timer, render target allocation/upload/residence remain unmeasured.
interpretation.instruments: QA-only diagnostic route and bounded events; unknown extensions retained as unknown. No diagnostics route is published by the normal production build. Detailed event arrays cap 500, so older per-stage events may be absent while summary spans remain recorded.

scenarios.cacheDefinition: cold: fresh context, HTTP browser cache explicitly cleared via CDP; no storage/SW from earlier context. warm: reload in same context, HTTP/CacheStorage/driver retained. OS/driver shader cache not controlled.
